attBesluta.text: These stanchions come exactly as described and shown on photos. They are easy to set up, look elegant and help to create partitions to aid safety. Would highly recommend due to the robust and high quality
The ropes helped create a clear waiting area without needing signs everywhere.

Great quality; heavy duty! I purchased these because it was cheaper to buy than to rent. I bought it for my son’s birthday party, but have used it for several other functions. I have purchased the ropes in other colors for different occasions.
We hosted a local awards event and these actually helped the entrance area look better in pictures.
Works great and exactly what I needed. Will definitely purchase again soon. The sticker is a little annoying but not a big deal to remove
Perfect for what I needed for events. Fast delivery and durable. Easy to assemble as well. Will definitely buy again
I'm Very satisfied with the product and shopping experience. Will purchase again from this company.

Great quality, very heavy & sturdy. They give a very classy and professional appearance. The cons are, that fingerprints show very easily and are difficult to remove. The cover for the bottom scratches easily.
Alles soweit in Ordnung. Nur die Samtseilhaken könnten etwas besser sein
Le produit est parfait! Merci! Malheureusement, je n'ai reçu que 2 cordons rouges sur les 3… mais je ne vous en veux pas, les erreurs peuvent arriver. Le produit est parfait! Merci à vous.

Le tableau est de grande qualité en apparence. Très esthétique. Bonne finition. En revanche le petit support en alu ne tient pas bien. Il glisse et finit par tomber (au milieu de la nuit;). Autre petit point négatif, il faut des aimants puissants. Le métal étant derrière la vitre, ne compter pas pouvoir accrocher des liasses de papiers. Ces 2 petits défauts mis à part, le tableau en lui même est vraiment très bien.
The magnetic feature is a let down given most magnets retail are not strong enough. Put 4 in the box and it’s perfect.
Alles bestens gelaufen, danke
Utilisé pour le dessous d'un abri de piscine, absolument parfait, robuste et flexible, tout à fait ce qu'il me fallait.

goes together easy. decent quality. only complaint is side canopy tubes are coupled with plastic that broke. I made a new 1 piece canopy bare but you could use metal sleeve or weld together and it should work fine. Also this is for 7 year old grand daughter so rough use
Great drum,the cymbals are 0/10 but if you change heads.. wowww

I purchased this Drum kit for my Grandson's birthday in July and I have to say I was surprised at the quality. He absolutely loves his Drum kit and for a beginner his managed to put it together himself and lives his kit just as much as we live him. Highly recommend for any level.

J'ai été surpris par la qualité de l'ensemble, c'est vraiment une belle batterie. Dommage que le kit n'inclue pas la cymbale ride que j'ai du trouver ailleurs. Je recommande après l'essai par un musicien confirmé qui fut lui aussi surpris. Mon point négatif: Arrêtez de sérigraphier VEVOR partout, sur un outil ca va bien mais sur une batterie c'est moins joli.
Drums were pretty easy to set up and surprisingly great quality (only surprising because of the cost. Great beginner set for my daughter.

The drums arrived excellently and securely packaged, with no damage. The shells are round and drumheads sits good on them. Replacing all drumheads is necessary, which is an expected additional expense., stock drumheads are very low quality. With good drumheads they sound like any other standard set, depending which drumheads you choose. The tom holders and hardware are lower in quality, but I was aware of that. I have better gear, so I purchased this kit primarily for the shells. I’ll be using it for regular rehearsal and as a backup for gigs. I appreciate customer service, which responded promptly to all my questions, l will definitely keep checking the site for more deals, especially anything at half price

Amazing quality Amazing price. I picked this set up for a student. I assembled it. It is a wonderful drum set. For a short while I will have two drum sets in my music room. I like the sound as much as my Tama professional. Thanks Vevor

This drum has great sound for a junior version and looks just like a full size drum set. I bought it for my 5 year old grandson and he loves it. It's a little bit tricky to keep it assembled tightly, but if you are familiar with drums it will probably be easy for you to set up and keep set up. I think it will work for him for another year or so depending on how fast he grows and how hard he uses it. I will definitely keep it for the next one. Highly recommend it for your musical child.
